import re

TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<state>Enabled|Disabled) by (?P<by>.+?) linters:\s*$")
LINTER = re.compile(r"^(?P<linter>\S+?)(?: \[(?P<status>[^\]]+)\])?: (?P<description>.*?)(?: \[(?P<flags>[^\]]+)\])?\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    rows, used = [], []
    state = ""
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m:
            state = m.group("state").lower()
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = LINTER.match(ln)
        if m:
            rows.append({"linter": m.group("linter"), "state": state,
                         "status": m.group("status") or "",
                         "description": m.group("description"),
                         "flags": m.group("flags") or ""})
            used.append(j)
    return [{"name": "linters", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": rows}]
